item.title: Hazleton Rotary to hold essay contest for high school juniors and seniors
item.description: Hazleton Rotary and Rotary District 7410 are again sponsoring an essay contest with cash prizes. The contest is open to high school juniors and seniors. This year’s theme relates to Rotary International’s theme “United for Good,” which reminds us that true progress begins when people come together with a shared purpose. item.title: Hazleton Rotary holds holiday party
item.description: Hazleton Rotary celebrated the holidays at its annual holiday party held at Four Blooms Restaurant, 668 N. Hunter Highway, Drums on Jan. 31. The organization sends thanks to Rotary Vice President Stephen Seach for planning the event, which was held to “celebrate the beauty of winter with the warmth of friendship”, a memorable thought for this time of the year. The members and leadership are looking forward to more Hazleton Rotary accomplishments and celebrations throughout 2026.
